title: Telling a piece to take the room left over has a key of its own
goal: Setting a piece in a stack to take the room the stack has left is only reachable by opening the panel and picking it out of a menu. It is the answer people reach for most while building a bar, so it should also be a menu item with a keyboard shortcut, the way lining a piece up already is.
notes: The edit already exists: PhotonzDocument.setFillsTheFlow(id:_:), wrapped by EditorState.setFillsTheFlow. Whether it is offered is Layer.canFillTheFlow(in:). The existing stretchSelectionAcross / stretchSelectionDown actions are the pattern to copy, including their playtest action names.
acceptance: An Arrange menu item turns filling on and off for the selected piece
It carries a keyboard shortcut and the shortcut is listed in the menu
It is greyed with a reason when the piece is not in a stack, or the stack has no room to spare
Pressing it a second time gives the piece back the size it had before
Tests in PhotonzCore cover when it is offered and when it is not
